{"metadata":{"description":"LongCat (LongCat-2.0) provider for DeepSeek Harness — 1M context, thinking mode, tool calling","id":"gh:1340213946","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-llm-longcat","slug":"ffyuuu/dsh-llm-longcat","topics":["agent","ai","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","llm","llm-adapter","llm-provider","longcat","meituan"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"LongCat (LongCat-2.0) provider for DeepSeek Harness — 1M context, thinking mode, tool calling"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-llm-longcat"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"LongCat adapter for the DeepSeek Harness LLM seam."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Adds **LongCat-2.0** as a model provider: 1M context, thinking mode, tool calling."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Thinking mode** — recognizes LongCat's `reasoning_content` field and translates it into harness "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"`ReasoningBlock`s
- **Tool calling** — full function-calling support, with `arguments` kept a raw JS"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ON string end to end
- **Multi-turn** — replays `reasoning_content` on tool-call turns, as thinking-"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"mode passback requires
- **Streaming** — SSE with the `usage`-before-`finish` ordering the harness r"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"elies on
- **Credential seam** — the key resolves per request from `ctx.credentials` or the environm"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ent; no secret in any config file"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Supported models"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Model | Context | Max output | Notes |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| `LongCat-2.0` | 1,048,576 | 131,072 | text-only; thinking + tool calling |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Facts from `GET /openai/v1/models/LongCat-2.0`, the only documented endpoint that
reports `supported"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"_parameters`. Tool calling is **not** mentioned on the
chat-completions doc page and is only visible"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ters`. Tool calling is **not** mentioned on the
chat-completions doc page and is only visible there."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Installing a bundle lets the package's install scripts run on your machine,
outside the sandbox the "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"agent runs under. Pin a commit so a later push cannot
change what executes:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Then pick **LongCat-2.0** in the model selector. The key may also be stored
through the Web UI's Mod"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"els page instead of the environment."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### If `dsh` itself will not install"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"At the time of writing, installing the harness can fail before any plugin is
reached, with either `E"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"TARGET … dsh-typert-protocol@^0.1.0-rc.8` or an npm
heap exhaustion. That is an upstream packaging s"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"tate, not this plugin:
`@deepseek-ai/dsh` published `0.1.0-rc.8` while several packages it depends o"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"n
stopped at `0.1.0-rc.7`, and because the manifests use caret ranges,
`^0.1.0-rc.7` still resolves "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"up into the missing `rc.8`. npm then backtracks
over an unsatisfiable graph until it runs out of mem"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"nto the missing `rc.8`. npm then backtracks
over an unsatisfiable graph until it runs out of memory."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Pinning every `@deepseek-ai/*` package to an exact `0.1.0-rc.7` through npm
`overrides` avoids the d"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"rift. Nothing in this plugin needs changing either
way — it declares `>=0.1.0-rc.7` and works agains"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"t whichever of those the
host ends up with."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"A `llm-longcat:` section in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` overrides any field
without a restart: base UR"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"L, catalog, request defaults, and idle budget all
take effect on the next request, while an in-fligh"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"t stream keeps the facts it
started with."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Reasoning is binary, deliberately"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"LongCat controls thinking with `thinking: {type: enabled|disabled}` and does
**not** accept OpenAI's"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" top-level `reasoning_effort` — its
`supported_parameters` lists the former and omits the latter. Th"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ere is
therefore no low/medium/high gradient to map, and this adapter offers exactly
two levels rath"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"er than advertising controls that would collapse onto the same
two request bodies:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Selected effort | Wire body |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `high` ("Thinking") | `{"thinking": {"type": "enabled"}}` |
| `off` | `{"thinking": {"type": "disa"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"bled"}}` |
| *(none named)* | resolves from config; still explicit |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"`off` serializes an explicit `disabled` rather than omitting the field —
omitting it would hand the "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"decision to LongCat's server-side default, which is
not what selecting Off should mean. Requesting `"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"low`, `medium`, or `max` fails
with `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT` before any network I/O."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Wire-format notes"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **Tool-call deltas repeat `id` and `name` as explicit `null`.** LongCat sends
them on the opening "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"delta and then `null` (not omitted) on every
continuation, so a naive `!== undefined` guard blanks t"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"he assembled call's
name. Verified on live traffic; pinned by a regression test.
- Streaming only, w"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ith `stream_options.include_usage` always on. Usage may
arrive attached to the finish chunk or as a "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"trailing usage-only chunk; both
are deferred to `[DONE]` so `usage` always precedes `finish`.
- The "},{"id":"p28s6","text":"first thinking-mode delta can be an empty string — it must not open a
reasoning block.
- **Reasoning"},{"id":"p28s7","text":" passback**: on assistant turns that carried tool calls,
`reasoning_content` is serialized back into"},{"id":"p28s8","text":" history; on tool-call-free turns
it is dropped (ignored anyway — saves tokens).
- Assistant `conten"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"t` is always a string, never null: the message is durable
session history, and a null there would ma"},{"id":"p28s10","text":"ke later turns replay a body the
endpoint can reject.
- Cache accounting: `prompt_tokens_details.cac"},{"id":"p28s11","text":"hed_tokens` maps to
`cacheReadTokens` and is subtracted out of `inputTokens` to keep the
harness's d"},{"id":"p28s12","text":"isjoint-count convention."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Errors"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Non-2xx responses throw `LlmError` with stable codes. LongCat documents a
dedicated **402** for exha"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"usted token quota and puts `insufficient_quota` on
**403**, where most OpenAI-compatible providers u"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"se 429 — both are classified
as `QUOTA` before the auth and rate-limit buckets, so a depleted balanc"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"e is
never reported as a bad key or retried as a transient rate limit."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Condition | Code |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| 402, or quota detail at any status | `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` |
| 401 / 403 | `AUTH` |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMIT"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"` |
| 400 with context-overflow detail | `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` |
| other 400 | `INVALID_REQUEST`"},{"id":"p32s3","text":" |
| 5xx | `SERVER` |
| no `[DONE]` / bad JSON | `STREAM_CLOSED` / `MALFORMED_RESPONSE` |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"A completed stream that opened no content blocks becomes a `finish` error with
`EMPTY_RESPONSE`, whi"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ch the shipped retry policy treats as retryable."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Tests"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"`test:e2e` drives the built adapter's own serialize → SSE → translate pipeline
against `api.longcat."},{"id":"p36s2","text":"chat`, so it verifies what the plugin actually sends
rather than a hand-written approximation. It is"},{"id":"p36s3","text":" what caught the null-name
delta bug."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- **No image input.** LongCat-2.0 reports `modality: text->text`, so image
content is refused before"},{"id":"p38s2","text":" sending, naming the model.
- **No stop sequences.** `stop` is absent from `supported_parameters`; p"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"assing
one fails with `UNSUPPORTED_OPTION` rather than silently running past it.
- **Reasoning is bi"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"nary** — no low/medium/high gradient exists to map."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
